summary: A failed agent run always lands its card in its stage's column with the Needs you pill.
user_story: When an agent run fails, its card always lands in its stage's column with the Needs you pill, so the owner can tell a broken run from one still working, even when the run's own last steps fail too.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a planner, plan review, worker or code review run fails (its agent crashed, or code rejected its hand-back), the issue's card, and its open pull request's, stays in that stage's column (Plan, Plan, Work, Review) and shows Needs you. That still holds when the run's own "Decide what follows" step fails as well, for example because GitHub answers 502. A run that hands on to the next agent still leaves the pill cleared.

non_functional.text: A run that left no record and no decision behind still puts its card in the column of the stage it was started for, with Needs you, and the board step exits 0.
non_functional.why: A failure the run could not even write down must not leave the card looking fine; the run's own failure, not the board step, is what the owner reads.

out_of_scope: Posting a failure comment on the issue; failed runs already post their record.
Adding the missing Next line to the record when deciding what follows fails.
Commands that fail in the listener (commands.yml) before any agent run starts; see the concern.
dokima/board.py and .github/workflows/board.yml: since #162 the river moves cards from agent.py, not from board events.
